title: cacalia ilicifolia
intro: Cacalia ilicifolia, commonly known as American bugleweed, is a perennial plant belonging to the family Campanulaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from anxiety, insomnia, and restlessness, thanks to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of American bugleweed include sedative, anti-anxiety, and antispasmodic effects. The bioactive constituents of the plant, such as flavonoids and phenolic acids, are responsible for its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to confirm the exact mechanisms.
